summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major features: XML/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown rendering, CLI integration, and GitHub Actions workflow validation. Unit tests via bun:test (parser, aggregator, summary, cli, workflow) are well-organized with realistic fixtures and proper cleanup. End-to-end integration tested through act-harness with two concrete matrix scenarios (flaky and all-green). Main gaps: edge cases like zero/extreme values, special characters, non-ASCII input not tested; some error scenarios (file I/O failures, permission errors) missing; act-harness limited to 2 test cases though they are realistic. No boundary value testing or stress testing. Design is clean and modular; fixtures are well-structured. Would catch most regressions effectively.
